cases.author: notatallshaw
cases.prompt: Support Python's __replace__ protocol on Specifier and SpecifierSet. Callers can override the operator/version of a single specifier, the specifiers in a set, or prerelease handling. Omitted fields retain their original values, and explicitly resetting prereleases to None restores automatic behavior. A no-op replacement returns the same object. Preserve the original on changes and reject invalid replacements. Document and test the API.

cases.author: CheckPickerUpper
cases.prompt: When the ignore walker is configured to apply Git excludes without requiring a Git repository, linked worktrees should honor the shared repository's info/exclude. Preserve behavior for ordinary directories and when Git excludes are disabled. Add regression coverage.

cases.author: Huang-404-Q
cases.prompt: Make halt_error emit the documented byte-exact stderr output for non-string inputs as well as strings. Preserve its exit status, stdout behavior, and existing null behavior. Add a regression that distinguishes an appended newline.

cases.author: ybai08
cases.complexity: TypeScript Markdown parser, interacting delimiter rules
cases.prompt: Bring emphasis parsing into line with CommonMark delimiter-run flanking and the multiple-of-three rule for runs of asterisks and underscores, including when a run can both open and close. Preserve ordinary emphasis, strong emphasis and intraword behavior. Add focused parser regression examples.

cases.author: hiddeco
cases.complexity: Go Git implementation, streamed decoding and file-mode semantics
cases.prompt: Make tree decoding agree with Git on octal file modes. Handle zero padding and modes that span a read buffer, canonicalize regular files using the owner execute bit, and return the malformed-tree error for invalid encodings. Expose Canonical on FileMode for Git's tree mode semantics. FromBytes accepts zero-padded octal values through uint32 and rejects overflow or invalid bytes. Preserve round trips, non-regular types and existing public contracts. Add regression coverage.

cases.author: justinthelaw
cases.complexity: GitHub Action, maintenance and immutable workflow pins
cases.prompt: Update the lint tooling to actions/setup-python v7.1.0 (upstream tag commit 6d4fd22b20465ccc0f7354476588e8df7c9ca0e0) and markdownlint-cli2 v0.24.0. Record both changes and any deferred upgrades in the repository's dependency ledger. Preserve supported runtime versions, action behavior and generated distribution.
